content.text: {"route":"gap","reason":"The record has material gaps. The investigator did not interview S1, who made the alleged comment about Complainant's sexual orientation, assigned the later OBO events and meetings, and was part of the decision to remove the portfolio. His departure from the Agency does not excuse the gap, since an affidavit could still have been sought. C1, the comparator who received the portfolio, was not interviewed, and the record has no data on C1's sex, sexual orientation or protected activity. This leaves the comparator analysis unsupported. The Agency's rebalancing rationale rests only on S2's statement, with no workload documents or evidence of other reassignments. The record also does not address the harassment allegations of constant scrutiny and unfair criticism, so the hostile work environment finding of 'generalized allegations' cannot be evaluated. The Agency's dismissal of reprisal also misses Complainant's claim that she opposed discrimination when she told S1 and S2 that assignments could not be based on assumptions about protected-group membership."}
